thread:
allen: FYI customer on Dedicated (AcmeCorp) is hitting invalid-JSON errors in json-mode after we moved them to redwood-3-od-v3.1 yesterday. They say it's intermittent and only on long outputs (>1k tokens) with streaming=true. They pasted an example where the JSON is truncated mid-object. request_id: r-0b9f12c3, region: us-west1.

allen: Customer sample (sanitized):
```json
{
  "prompt": "summarize long document",
  "json_schema": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "summary": {"type": "string"},
      "metadata": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "id": {"type": "string"}
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "stream": true
}
```

allen: Example failing response (customer):
```
{"summary":"Long summary text ...","metadata":{"id":"abc123","tags":["foo","bar"]}  <-- then stream stops abruptly, next bytes missing
```

allen: Error they see from their JSON parser: `Unexpected end of input` and from our side they've captured: `parse_error: EOF while reading object` in their logs. They say switching to model redwood-3-od-v3.0.2 stops the problem.

cassie: Thanks. Can you attach the raw stream capture (if they have it) + the curl they used? Also which SDK (python/js) and which runtime version (console shows runtime 2.6.1 for that pool)?

allen: Attaching sanitized curl and small capture below. SDK is python v1.8. Curl they used: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-live-xxx'
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
  -d '{"model":"redwood-3-od-v3.1","prompt":"<long doc>","json_schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"summary":{"type":"string"}}},"stream":true}'
```

allen: They also forwarded a tcpdump of server->client chunks (sanitized). It shows final chunk length=0 after a chunk that ends with `..."tags": ["foo",` and then client-side reconstruct yields truncated JSON.

mohit: This smells like streaming chunk boundaries + how we emit `delta` tokens vs final chunk. Two hypotheses: (1) model v3.1 emits different tokenization which pushes a closing brace into the next chunk; our streaming edge-case in runtime 2.6.1 sometimes emits a final empty chunk early (race), leaving client with incomplete JSON. (2) There may be an off-by-one in the streaming flusher when content length crosses 1024B boundary for a given batching window.

mohit: Quick repro request for SRE: can you 1) replay the exact request_id r-0b9f12c3 in debug mode, 2) try with stream=false to confirm it completes fine, 3) try stream=true but set `max_tokens` smaller to see if length correlates.

cassie: I repro'd locally with a long synthetic prompt. With stream=true + runtime 2.6.1 I occasionally see truncated last chunk when the total serialized JSON exceeds ~1200 bytes. With stream=false the JSON is valid always.

cassie: Stack trace from runtime: `stream_emitter: write_chunk -> maybe_flush -> write(0) returning early` (sanitized). Filing an eng-runtime bug.

allen: Customer tried stream=false and got valid JSON. They want streaming though for progressive UX. They're asking for mitigation option.

mohit: Mitigations: a) short-term: advise customers to set stream=false for critical JSON parsing or add a small client-side reassembly+timeout to wait for EOF before parsing; b) medium-term: runtime patch to ensure when `json_mode` is enabled we buffer final chunks and only emit a final `eof` after verifying parentheses/bracket balance for top-level object; c) long-term: model onboarding checks — compare tokenization length deltas and run a suite that generates streaming-large JSON to detect regressions.

cassie: I've opened ENG-RUNTIME-4873 and attached reproducer + logs. Assigning to @mohit for triage. Patch candidate: bump runtime flush threshold and ensure `Content-Length`/chunking aligns with token boundaries for streaming responses.

mohit: I'll try a hotfix to the flusher to always append a final 2-byte newline and ensure 0-length chunk emitted only after full flush. Also check kernel changes that affect token emission ordering.

infra-bot: deploy request queued: runtime/2.6.1-hotfix-2026-03-17 -> staging (owner: mohit).

allen: I'll reply to the customer: short-term ask them to switch stream=false while we validate a hotfix; offer concessions if they need streaming in prod. Also capture any SDK-level parsing helpers we can offer (e.g., wrapper that waits for stream end).

cassie: For the incident ticket, severity P2 right now (customer has workaround). If more customers report this escalate to P1.

mohit: One more datapoint — I compared tokenizer outputs between v3.0.2 and v3.1 for the same prompt. v3.1 creates one extra token at the end in ~12% of samples which is enough to push a closing brace into next chunk. That plus the flusher bug explains intermittent nature.

allen: Thanks team — I'll send customer note and keep thread updated.

cassie: Updating ENG-RUNTIME-4873 with the tokenizer diffs and the tcpdump sample.

mohit: Will post link to staging deploy and ask support to validate with the customer's exact request later today.

allen: ack.
